correction_reason: The v1 freeze incorrectly encoded ad-hoc seed IDs despite specifying reuse of the existing six-seed ensemble. V1 results are not admitted to the manuscript. V2 restores the pre-existing seed ensemble from data/design/chapter2_finite_community_system_size_freeze_20260908.json; no outcome-dependent seed choice is made.
question: Does the variance hierarchy reverse with increasing community system size when the headline plant adjustment operator (trait_adjustment=0.03) is active?
primary_prediction: Across system-size multipliers, community-realization share should decline and starting-position share should increase under trait_adjustment=0.03; a seed-stable rank crossover would imply that the hierarchy of response determinants is regime dependent.
decision_rule: Call rank crossover seed-stable only if starting_position_ss_fraction exceeds community_realization_ss_fraction at k=16 in at least 5 of 6 pre-existing seeds and the median starting-position share increases monotonically across k while the median community share decreases monotonically.
claim_boundary: This audit tests regime dependence of the variance hierarchy inside the existing synthetic model. It does not establish natural frequencies, historical causation, or a universal finite-N threshold in real pollination systems.
